skill.name: implement
skill.description: Implements scoped work from a PRD or issue set with regular checks, final testing, code review, and a commit.
skill.summary: Execute PRD or issue work with incremental verification and review.
skill.author: mattpocock

security_audit.summary: The skill contains only prompt instructions and no executable code. No static findings or semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, or malicious intent were found.

content.value_statement: Detailed requirements can still produce inconsistent implementation and verification. This skill executes PRD or issue work with regular checks, final testing, review, and commit.
actual_capabilities: Implements work described in a PRD or set of issues.
Uses the TDD workflow where possible at pre-agreed seams.
Runs type checking and focused test files regularly during implementation.
Runs the full test suite once after implementation is complete.
Uses the code review workflow after completing the work.
Commits completed work to the current branch.
limitations: Requires a clear PRD or issue set from the user.
Does not define project-specific commands, dependencies, or acceptance criteria.
References TDD and code review workflows that must be available separately.
Commits to the current branch, so users should confirm the branch and staged changes.

use_cases.title: Deliver a Product Requirement
use_cases.description: Implement a defined feature from its PRD, verify it incrementally, review the result, and commit the completed work.

use_cases.title: Resolve a Scoped Issue Set
use_cases.description: Complete related repository issues while keeping tests and type checks active throughout the implementation.

use_cases.title: Execute Approved Engineering Work
use_cases.description: Apply an agreed implementation process with TDD seams, final validation, code review, and a branch commit.

prompt_templates.title: Implement One Issue
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement [issue]. Run type checking and focused tests regularly. Run the full test suite, review the result, and commit the completed work.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a small, clearly defined repository issue.

prompt_templates.title: Build from a PRD
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement [PRD] against [acceptance criteria]. Use TDD at the agreed seams. Verify focused tests throughout, then run full tests, review, and commit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a feature with documented requirements and acceptance criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Related Issues
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement issues [list] in dependency order. Keep each change scoped and verified. Complete full testing and code review before committing to the current branch.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a coordinated set of related engineering tasks.

prompt_templates.title: Implement a Cross-Cutting Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Implement [requirement] across [modules]. Apply TDD at [agreed seams] and preserve [constraints]. Validate incrementally, review all changes, then commit.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for advanced work spanning several modules with explicit constraints.

output_examples.input: Implement issue 142: validate profile email updates and add tests.
output: Implemented profile email validation with focused coverage for valid, malformed, and duplicate addresses.
Type checking, focused tests, and the full suite passed before code review and commit.

output_examples.input: Implement the billing retry PRD with TDD around payment state transitions.
output: Completed the retry workflow at the agreed payment-state seams without changing unrelated billing behavior.
Ran regular type checks and focused tests, then completed the full suite and code review.
Committed the reviewed implementation to the current branch.

best_practices: Provide the complete PRD, issue text, and acceptance criteria before implementation.
Agree on TDD seams and project verification commands before work begins.
Confirm the current branch and staged files before allowing the final commit.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation from vague requirements without acceptance criteria.
Delaying all focused tests until the full suite runs at the end.
Mixing unrelated refactors into the requested implementation.

faq.question: What input does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide a PRD, one issue, or a related set of issues with enough detail to implement.

faq.question: Does this skill use test-driven development?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses TDD where possible at seams agreed before implementation.

faq.question: How does it verify the implementation?
faq.answer: It runs type checking and focused tests regularly, then runs the full test suite once at the end.

faq.question: Does it review completed work?
faq.answer: Yes. It invokes the code review workflow after implementation and final testing.

faq.question: Does it commit changes automatically?
faq.answer: The workflow instructs the agent to commit completed work to the current branch.

faq.question: Are project commands included?
faq.answer: No. The repository must provide its own type checking, test, TDD, and code review workflows.
